mac-optical-state amalgamated distribution
Version:  0.4.0

Files:
  mos.h — public API
  mos.c — implementation (concatenated from src/)

Build:
  Compile:  cc -c mos.c -mmacosx-version-min=12.0
  Link:     cc mos.o your_main.o -o yourtool \
               -framework IOKit \
               -framework CoreFoundation \
               -framework DiscRecording \
               -framework DiskArbitration \
               -mmacosx-version-min=12.0

License: 0BSD (see repository)
Source:  https://github.com/napieraj/mos
